list.title: Messages
list.emptyDescription: Write to a candidate from one of your jobs: your conversations will appear here.
list.pick: Choose a conversation to display it.
list.deleteExplain: The conversation will disappear from your list only. The other person keeps it, and it will come back if they write to you again.

thread.closed: This conversation has ended: you can no longer write.
thread.noPlan: Choose a plan to write to candidates: you can read your conversations.
thread.actionsDeleteExplain: The message will be removed on both sides. The other person will see that a message was deleted.

warning.header: Phone numbers and emails don't go through here. Hire the candidate to get their contact details.
warning.sender: This part wasn't sent: contact details don't go through in messages.
warning.recipient: Phone numbers and emails don't go through here. Hire the candidate to get their contact details.
warning.held: This message wasn't sent: it contained contact details.
warning.reportDone: Thank you, your report has been recorded.

bulk.sent: {count, plural, one {Message sent to # candidate} other {Message sent to # candidates}}.
bulk.skipped: {count, plural, one {# couldn't receive it.} other {# couldn't receive it.}}
bulk.title: {count, plural, one {Write to the candidate} other {Write to the # candidates}}
bulk.description: Each one gets their own message, with their first name: in Messages for a Rabotka candidate, by email for an application from your careers page.
bulk.noContact: · no phone number, email or link for Rabotka candidates.

templates.title: Message templates
templates.subtitle: Written once, sent with a rejection or to several candidates at once.
templates.editorHint: Words in curly braces are replaced for each candidate.
templates.noContact: For Rabotka candidates, the message arrives in Messages: no phone number, email or link.
